searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he critique and twenty improvements the awtsmoos turns critique into clearer form; awtsmoos.com lets every hidden edge become warm. 1. keep canonical records data only so both runtimes can validate them. 2. add schema versioning before persistence fields are introduced. 3. separate affinity identity from element identity. 4. separate action definition from runtime action state. 5. separate status definition from active status instance. 6. return structured effectiveness diagnostics, not only final damage. 7. model contextual tags such as airborne, soaked, guarded, hidden, and channeling. 8. bound every status stack and every replay token ledger. 9. store interrupt resistance and remaining resistance separately. 10. make interruption receipts idempotent and cast instance specific. 11. require pre launch validation before projectile creation. 12. filter daas insight on the server by tier. 13. give local authority the same resolver api as multiplayer authority. 14. preserve existing melee timings and add affinity metadata through the factory. 15. preserve existing torah ability identities while enriching their typed records. 16. introduce enemy affinity profiles independently from enemy spawn identity. 17. use presentation adapters so low quality effects never alter rules. 18. keep optional visual families dynamically imported. 19. add migration defaults that preserve existing saves without reallocating player choices. 20. add focused parity tests that feed identical contexts to local and server resolvers. critique of the initial direction the first plan was too eager to create many shared json files without proving the repository's existing load conventions. it also treated ui and effects as later decoration, although cast readability is part of combat correctness. the improved direction must first establish the smallest shared schema, wire one complete vertical slice through client prediction and server authority, and only then expand the catalog. improved first slice implement affinities, elements, typed action fields, contextual effectiveness, bounded core statuses, daas insight tiers, and interrupt metadata for one chochmah projectile, one binah cast, one z"a water cast, one malchus control cast, existing melee, and representative enemy actions. prove this slice in both local and multiplayer authority before multiplying content.

authority use identical ids and equivalent rules. phase f — verification 20. add focused tests after production wiring. 21. run client and server matrices. 22. build compactjs twice and compare manifests. 23. build canonical css twice and compare manifests. 24. run isolated performance profiling. 25. run desktop, mobile, landscape, reduced motion, high contrast, offline, reconnect, webgl failure, and canvas2d browser acceptance. 26. audit syntax, imports, tabs, whitespace, line counts, processes, and worktree state.

Begin with shared definitions that existing catalogs can consume incrementally. 2. Avoid static import of option
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he final critique and thirty additional improvements the awtsmoos reveals the missing edge before the blade can stray; awtsmoos.com keeps every correction recorded on the way. 1. begin with shared definitions that existing catalogs can consume incrementally. 2. avoid static import of optional effect families in the fallback bootstrap. 3. preserve current action ids to avoid save and network breakage. 4. add aliases only through one migration table. 5. validate hebrew names and english translations as required fields. 6. keep element and affinity ids lowercase and stable. 7. make diagnostic ordering deterministic for snapshot tests. 8. clamp every numeric multiplier and duration. 9. make immunity explicit rather than encoded as zero damage alone. 10. treat critical interaction as a labeled rule, not a random critical hit. 11. distinguish guard damage, stagger damage, interrupt force, and health damage. 12. distinguish poise from concentration so melee and casting remain readable. 13. reset interrupt resistance only through explicit cast lifecycle transitions. 14. use cast instance ids to reject stale completion after reconnect. 15. include action version in authoritative receipts. 16. keep server insight payloads independent from private resistance records. 17. make daas tiers monotonic and test each disclosure boundary. 18. preserve existing equipment derived legacy damage and defense. 19. add affinity derived mechanics without universal multipliers. 20. record status source, source action, source actor, application time, and expiry. 21. apply cleanse rules before new status reactions when ordering matters. 22. define deterministic reaction precedence for burn, soak, grounding, and illumination. 23. keep active status collections keyed and bounded. 24. use compact snapshots for multiplayer interest updates. 25. keep local authority in a separate adapter, not conditionals scattered through gameplay. 26. add world state tags through a narrow environment context provider. 27. treat accessibility text as required presentation data. 28. treat effect cancellation as part of cast cancellation tests. 29. measure initial bundle inclusion after every new import boundary. 30. delay full catalog expansion until the first vertical slice proves identity, authority, ui, and cleanup. final revelation the implementation must not attempt the entire content matrix before proving the canonical machinery. the first production pass will establish the shared domain, enrich current action catalogs, provide authoritative effectiveness and status receipts, and create tests. further enemy, hud, effect, persistence, loading, and browser work will then extend the same truth without replacement.
